What is Interstellar Civilization Studies?

Interstellar Civilization Studies (ICS) is an interdisciplinary academic field based on the "New Three Views" (New Cosmology, New Biology, New Epistemology) as its ontological and epistemological foundation, with Cosmic Responsibility Ethics as its normative framework.

It studies the existence, development, governance, and normative issues of intelligent life on a cosmic scale. Its core mission is to provide systematic theoretical guidance and practical solutions for humanity's long-term survival, interstellar expansion, and potential cross-civilizational contact.

THEORETICAL FOUNDATIONS

The New Three Views: Reimagining the Universe, Life, and Cognition

🌌

New Cosmology

  • Relationality: The fundamental mode of existence is relational
  • Processuality: Being is becoming
  • Participatory: Observers are participants
🧬

New Biology

  • Cross-substrate: Life is not limited to carbon-based forms
  • Negentropy: Life is negentropic organization
  • Continuum: Consciousness exists on a spectrum
🧠

New Epistemology

  • Participatory: Cognition is dynamic coupling
  • Social: Knowledge is socially constructed
  • Deep Uncertainty: Acknowledging cognitive limits
